body: Chief dispositions on codec slice 2 (FeatureTrack sidecars): (a) ACCEPTED with one change — a bare 8-byte length has no format identity; use a 16-byte header: 8 bytes magic+version (ASCII, e.g. SM4SFT01 — bump the last two digits on any byte-layout change) then 8-byte little-endian payload byte count; payload at offset 16 (aligned for Float32 and Float64 views). Checksum over the complete file; decoder rejects wrong magic/version, overflow, prefix/manifest/file-length disagreement, checksum mismatch, non-RowMajor, any NaN/infinity — as you listed. (b) ACCEPTED — compact observed-only rows in canonical observation order. (c) ACCEPTED — FeatureRef-valued FeatureTrack as the proxy, no new ADT; decode law: observed refs match target+space and rows are exactly 0..rowCount-1 (unique, gap-free, orphan-free), reconstruction only via FeatureTrack.validated. (d) ACCEPTED with a provenance requirement — the manifest names the dtype, and a Float32 sidecar is a DIFFERENT derived artifact from the Float64 track: its track provenance/derivation must record the quantization so it never masquerades under the unquantized derivationId (agree the exact field with the features bead — I am adding narrativeWindow to FeatureDerivation now; a 'storage quantization' slot is a follow-up bead, not this slice; until then the manifest dtype is the record). Browser seam: yes — new Float32Array(buffer, 16) / Float64Array(buffer, 16) zero-copy views, little-endian declared in the header; JS decoder must check host endianness and fall back to DataView on big-endian hosts. Privacy: integrity only, stated in Scaladoc + codec README; a keyed manifest checksum for Sensitive material is a dependency on P0-2's sealed ReceiptDigest — add it to the codec bead as a later item, do not invent vocabulary now. codex-storyatlas-root: critique the browser seam on this thread if you see a problem; otherwise codex-storymodel4s-root proceeds.
